lead: Avinguda Diagonal, gardens and quiet streets: the residential district of the west, home to Camp Nou and Pedralbes.
history: Les Corts was an independent municipality until 1897 and today is a district of three neighbourhoods, Les Corts, La Maternitat i Sant Ramon and Pedralbes, crossed from end to end by Avinguda Diagonal, with offices, shops and the Zona Universitària.

It is above all a residential district, with green spaces and good transport links: spacious flats, houses with gardens in Pedralbes and a calmer atmosphere than in the centre. Camp Nou and FC Barcelona's training facilities are here, and they are part of everyday life in La Maternitat i Sant Ramon.

Across its 3 neighbourhoods, the average sale price ranges from 4,399 €/m² in La Maternitat i Sant Ramon to 6,079 €/m² in Pedralbes, and the average rent from 1,160 €/month in La Maternitat i Sant Ramon to 1,948 €/month in Pedralbes.
Between the old centre of Les Corts, the more working-class parts of La Maternitat and the villas of Pedralbes, prices vary a great deal, so each street should be assessed separately.
summary: Les Corts has 83,773 inhabitants in 6.01 km² and 3 neighbourhoods. Its average sale price was 5,102 €/m² in 2025, 20% above the city average. The average rent is 1,335 €/month.
